parsing_rule: records grouped strictly by the per-record 'arm' field; no line-number addressing
units_rule: posterior_nll/posterior_entropy reported raw (per block of n=1024) and as bits/symbol; comparisons against reference entropies use bits/symbol only

b2_sentinel.sentinel_definition: l2_errors_final==1024 AND terminal_decoder_status=='not_run': L1 failed so L2 never ran and x2_hat does not exist (C2)

semantic_labels.B1: active divergence observation; attribution barred by C1 (generator/posterior law mismatch)
semantic_labels.B2: not-run sentinel only (C2); excluded from trajectory/divergence statistics

full_population_rule: every conclusion rests on full-population counts/distributions above; single-sample anecdotes are forbidden as evidence

P-i_B1_active_divergence_observation.attribution_note: observation stands (if passed) but attribution to the fixed QC graph or decoder is BARRED by C1: B1 samples follow generator law Q_B1 while the posterior follows the V25 empirical joint P(A,B)

P-ii_B2_sentinel_not_run.attribution_note: l2_errors_final==1024 with terminal_decoder_status=='not_run' is the not-run sentinel (L1 failed -> L2 never ran, x2_hat does not exist); it is NOT divergence evidence (C2)

P-iii_B3B4_improve_but_no_syndrome.attribution_note: improve-but-no-syndrome semantics per C3; the word 'divergent' is never applied to B3/B4
